observations.behavior: The paginator's __init__ no longer accepts a positional-only base_page; it now accepts maximum_page as a keyword argument, while retaining the same super().__init__ call. This could support reuse of the paginator with a configurable page limit.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to configure pagination behavior without changing the page parameter, potentially supporting incremental or bounded pagination. This could help avoid over-fetching or support resumption with a page limit.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper _client_config that returns a ClientConfig dict, including a paginator and a session with redaction and capture=False. This could support reuse of the client configuration across paginated and single-page endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Could support warehouse ingestion to reuse a shared client configuration, potentially supporting pagination and redaction. This could help avoid over-fetching or support resumption with a page limit.
